source_evidence: D327~10:19 V asks exactly 'I understand he represent your house in many ways, just wanted to know how much is run by you if I am to work with him'. Halvessa describes her legitimate relationship with Tavosk: he is an independent commercial petition representative serving multiple interests, not her household employee or exclusive representative. She claims her standing and support give her influence over the commercial causes she backs, but he cannot bind another House to her wishes. She personally sets her household's broad commercial priorities and approves substantial new commitments; Sallow administers ordinary purchases and arrangements. These are her own statements of ordinary authority and public affiliation, not verified proof of particular purchases, secret payments, the 250gp prospective investment or knowing personal authorization of L-9. She offers that V could retain Tavosk independently and that cooperation on shared river interests might be mutually useful, asking what V wants him to achieve. No actual introduction, contract, proposal accepted, confession, roll, money, new suspect arrival or evidence disclosure. No independently verified exclusive control or change in public petition. All prior custody and resources unchanged. Await V reply.
